The comment about "debugging everyday stuff outta habit now" suggests they've been coding long enough for it to become a habit, which might be a few years in, so maybe mid-20s to 30s.

They also mention "not everyone rediscovers lost passions when flying solo sometimes it’s just more time scrolling through apps than strumming guitars." This could indicate they're in a phase where they're single or not in a relationship, which is common across various ages, but the mention of "flying solo" might be more common in younger adults.

The user says "who says settling improves life? I'd rather level up solo." This could imply they're in their 30s, as "leveling up" might relate to career or personal growth, which people often focus on in their 30s.

Looking at the life events, there's no specific year mentioned, so we can't calculate an exact birth year.
